audit.source_text: Andy Warhol was a successful magazine and ad illustrator who became a leading artist of the 1960s Pop art movement.

As evidenced by the artist’s signature and date on the verso of the canvas, 1 Colored Marilyn (reversal series), is one of the earliest works from a series of oil and silkscreen paintings completed by Andy Warhol between 1979 - 1986.
The Painting, which carried a pre-sale estimate of $1,500,000 - $2,000,000 in Phillips’ November 2017 New York auction, measures 46.4 cm by 34.9 cm (18 ¼ in x 13 ¾ in) and was created in 1979.
